name: Position
definition: Specifies the status of trades and their value inside a system.

NetPositionAmount.name: Net Position Amount
NetPositionAmount.definition: Specifies the net position amount of the trade legs of one member within the system.

InitialPositionAmount.name: Initial Position Amount
InitialPositionAmount.definition: Specifies the position at the beginning of a reporting period.

NetQuantity.name: Net Quantity
NetQuantity.definition: Specifies the net quantity position of the trade legs of one member within the system.

System.name: System
System.definition: System for which trades position is specified.

SecuritiesSettlement.name: Securities Settlement
SecuritiesSettlement.definition: Information related to the settlement of the position.
